ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65% high-intensity white pixels to 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lateral lobes consist of two large contiguous white regions. Dark pigmentation is concentrated at the peduncle insertion point and forms a continuous band along the entire trailing edge and leading edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch; approximately 135-degree angle with a depth of roughly 12% of the lobe's vertical extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the full trailing edge; peaks occur approximately every 10-20 pixels with an amplitude of 3-8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong convex curvature from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges are relatively straight with a slight concave taper at the extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark circular pixel clusters (likely barnacle scars) scattered sparsely across the high-intensity white fields, most notably on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive diagonal parallel lines (rake marks) crossing the white regions of both lobes, predominantly oriented toward the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent predatory rake marks (parallel scarring) visible across both ventral lobes; significantly irregular and jagged distal edges on both tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The trailing edge near the tips exhibits a 'shredded' appearance with deep, irregular indentations that break the otherwise continuous curve.
